title: AquaPredict Rescue Priority Predictor Metadata
disclaimer: SCENARIO-BASED FLOOD RESCUE DECISION SUPPORT PROTOTYPE — NOT A CERTIFIED 911 DISPATCH SYSTEM

road_failure_risk.definition: An access road or primary connecting road to the facility/neighborhood exceeds the modeled waterlogging depth threshold (>= 0.30m vehicle impassability threshold).
road_failure_risk.routing_implication: Vehicular access is disrupted along at least one corridor, requiring detours.

community_isolation_risk.definition: All viable ingress/egress connecting routes to the location are impassable due to modeled waterlogging, or the location is isolated from the municipal road network.
community_isolation_risk.routing_implication: Complete road access severance; requires priority amphibious, high-clearance, or emergency aerial response.

priority_ranking_system.Priority 1: Critical facilities (Hospitals, Trauma centers, Healthcare clinics) experiencing road failure or isolation.
priority_ranking_system.Priority 2: Communities, residential areas, societies, or villages experiencing complete Community Isolation Risk.
priority_ranking_system.Priority 3: Communities, residential areas, societies, or villages experiencing Road Failure Risk with alternative detours available.
priority_ranking_system.Priority 4+: Subordinate road disruptions ranked by maximum modeled water depth.

data_provenance.locations_source: City of Houston Enterprise GIS (DIR/healthandPublicSafety_gx, DIR/ReferenceAndBoundaries_gx, DIR/Parks_gx)
data_provenance.flood_depth_source: AquaPredict M5 Scenario Simulation depth grid (100x100 resolution)
data_provenance.road_network_source: AquaPredict M7 Street Centerlines Network Graph (160 nodes, 210 edges)
